summary: Split god module todo2code_discovery by responsibility

delivery.outcome: Split src/koru/autonomy/todo2code_discovery.py (code2llm god module: 846 lines, 5 classes) by responsibility into three modules behind a stable facade: todo2code_config.py (os.environ-then-.env knob lookup _env_flag/_env_float/_env_int plus the _config_value re-export from koru.queue.todo2code_support, todo2code_enabled, output-dir containment _out_dir, discovery limit resolution _discovery_limits, and the shared defaults DEFAULT_SOURCE/DEFAULT_OUT_SUBDIR/DEFAULT_MAX_TICKETS/DEFAULT_STALE_MINUTES/DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS/DEFAULT_MIN_USEFULNESS), todo2code_plans.py (plan artifact discovery PLANS_FILENAME/find_latest_plans_path, freshness _plans_fresh, JSON loading _load_plan_set, and plan-field normalization _string_list/_truncate/_plan_paths/_plan_dedupe_key/_slug) and todo2code_tickets.py (sprint dedupe identities _ExistingPlanTickets/_read_sprint_tickets/_remember_todo2code_ticket/_existing_todo2code_keys, ticket text and scaffold assembly _PRIORITY_MAP/_file_evidence/_ticket_title/_ticket_plan_lines/_ticket_change_lines/_ticket_risk_lines/_ticket_recovery_lines/_ticket_text/_ticket_scaffold, usefulness ranking _RankedPlans/_rank_useful_plans, and planfile filing _relative_plans_path/_PlanIdentity/_plan_identity/_resolve_plan_priority/_enrich_plan_scaffold/_PlanDispatch/_dispatch_plan_task/_file_plan_ticket/_record_plan_dispatch/_apply_plan_tickets). todo2code_discovery.py keeps only the pipeline (Runner, Todo2codeDiscoveryOutcome, _default_runner, _run_t2c_pipeline, _consume_plan_set, run_todo2code_discovery, format_todo2code_summary) and re-exports every moved name with redundant aliases so 'from koru.autonomy.todo2code_discovery import ...' stays working, including the test-facing _t2c_executable patch target consumed by run_todo2code_discovery through facade globals, scan.py's _PRIORITY_MAP/_plan_dedupe_key/DEFAULT_SOURCE and code_change_autonomy.py's _config_value/_out_dir. Behavior is preserved verbatim (functions move unmodified); the four existing test_todo2code_* test files pass unchanged and tests/test_todo2code_modules.py pins the moved behavior at its new homes plus the facade re-export surface and the facade-level _t2c_executable patch path.
nonGoals: Changing discovery behavior, skip reasons, freshness semantics, dedupe identities or ticket scaffolds
Renaming environment knobs, defaults or the os.environ-before-.env lookup order
Touching src/koru/scan.py, src/koru/autonomy/code_change_autonomy.py, src/koru/autonomy/phases/scan_phase.py, src/koru/ide_doctor_cli.py or any other consumer
Modifying the existing test_todo2code_* test files
Splitting or refactoring any other module flagged by code2llm

architecture.decision: Move functions verbatim (same private names) into three responsibility modules and re-export them from the koru.autonomy.todo2code_discovery facade with redundant aliases (the nxdo_discovery pattern from ticket-234). A patch audit found exactly one facade-level monkeypatch target (tests patch td._t2c_executable, consumed by run_todo2code_discovery, which stays in the facade and resolves the name through facade globals at call time) and one cross-module patch target (koru.tasks.create_nl_task, consumed by _dispatch_plan_task through a function-local import that moves with it), so plain import-time re-exports suffice without call-time facade indirection; the facade __all__ is unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit to restore the single 846-line src/koru/autonomy/todo2code_discovery.py.

validation.evidence: todo2code_discovery.py drops from 846 lines to the pipeline facade; each responsibility module stays a focused non-god module (function count under the code2llm gate of 40).
